subject: ventures/square-sales-to-journal
professional: a bookkeeper who closes monthly books for Square merchants (cafes, salons, market stalls). First checks: does the journal balance and equal the deposits, are tax and tips liabilities, are fees an expense, and does the Square clearing account actually clear to zero against bank deposits once cash, gift-card and other non-card tenders and refunds are in the month.

evidence.correctness: Squareup.com help pages (Transactions report column definitions) returned proxy 403, so recomputed by hand from double-entry practice on CSVs written by hand in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-oss-monorepo/20d3eb67-43fe-5ab8-a54f-4c717b426b39/scratchpad/sq_audit.mjs (not via the author's buildReport). Card-only month: Cr Sales 260.00, Dr Discounts 5.00, Cr Gift Cards Outstanding 25.00, Cr Sales Tax Payable 21.04, Cr Tips Payable 20.00, Dr Refunds 20.00, Dr Fees 9.62, Dr Square Clearing 291.42; balanced, equals the summed Net Total, deposit totals D100 68.59 / D101 137.42 / D102 85.41 all match hand figures. $1,234.56 thousands separator, DD/MM dates and a Pending row handled. Wrong outputs: (1) a cash sale ($10.80) and a Square gift card redemption ($21.60) are debited to Square Clearing (63.67 vs the one card deposit 31.27), so clearing never clears and the gift card liability is never relieved; the Cash / Square Gift Card / Other Tender columns are ignored. (2) A $54 partial refund that includes $4 tax books Dr Refunds 54 and leaves Sales Tax Payable at 8.00 instead of 4.00. (3) An export with Net Total but no Fees column (accepted by the column check, calc.mjs:140) books no fee: Clearing 43.30 vs Net Total 41.84, with an error on every row. (4) When a row fails the Collected+Fees=Net check, the journal uses Collected+Fees (Clearing 50.76, fee credited as income) while the month check and deposit table use Net Total (47.84), though the message says 'The journal uses the Net Total'.
evidence.completeness: Claimed features checked by run: per-row Collected+Fees=Net check (works, flags), separate gross/discount/tax/tips/gift card/refund/fee lines (works), one journal per calendar month dated month end (works), balanced to clearing (works), Deposit ID totals across months (works), typed-in month Net Total proof (works; ignored with an info finding for multi-month files), uncategorised remainder (works for unexplained Total Collected), Xero / QBO / IIF / plain CSV exports (generated and balance; layouts self-declared as from memory, never imported). Status filter skips Pending/Voided. No TODOs. Gaps: tenders, no-Fees export path, a month that nets to zero emits a single 0.00 Clearing line (IIF TRNS with no SPL) that an importer may refuse.
evidence.verification: cd ventures/square-sales-to-journal && node --test '*.test.mjs': 30/30 pass, ~0.11 s. Seven mutants via platform/ci/quality_mutate.py on calc.mjs: refunds sign flip caught; Collected+Fees check disabled caught; journal debit/credit swap caught; DD/MM vs MM/DD order inverted SURVIVED; refund-status acceptance removed SURVIVED; expected-total applied to multi-month files SURVIVED; discounts -abs(disc) -> disc SURVIVED (equivalent on the sample, which prints discounts negative, so positive-printed discounts are untested). 3 of 7 caught. Tests are built from the author's own buildReport, so they cannot find a layout misreading; no test has a cash or gift-card tender row.
evidence.craft: Read calc.mjs (350 lines), calc.test.mjs, page.test.mjs, usage.mjs, index.html. Good: integer cents throughout, quoted-CSV splitter, BOM/UTF-16 decode, formula-injection guard on exports, findings with line numbers, every module pure. Residue from the sibling engine: parseMoney/parseStatementDate comments say 'Etsy', variables named payouts/payoutId for months, parseStatementDate and MONTHS unused here, buildReport has a dead '(it.gift ? 0 : 0)', the net/tz/txn columns are read but unused. The check at calc.mjs:168 and the journal at :173-174 use different totals for the same row.
evidence.claims: Backed: 'checks every payment' (calc.mjs:168), tax and tips as liabilities (CATEGORIES), one journal per month, Deposit ID totals, month proof, 'a test asserts no network calls' (page.test.mjs:17-21), no upload, disclaimer and non-affiliation present, 'read from memory' limit stated on page and in VENTURE.yaml. Served llms.txt clean (node platform/pages/served-copy.mjs square-sales-to-journal). FAIL: FAQ (index.html:126) says a gift card redemption is a remainder journalled to uncategorised; a redemption is fully explained by the sales columns and lands in Square Clearing (scenario 2). FAIL: index.html:112 'Square clearing, which should return to zero once every deposit is matched' is false for any month with cash or gift-card tenders. FAIL: calc.mjs:168 finding text 'The journal uses the Net Total' is false (scenario 5).
evidence.fitness: Walked the job: export a month, paste, type the Net Total, download QBO CSV, post, match deposits. For a card-only merchant this works and is better than booking the deposit. For the stated audience (cafes, salons, food trucks, market stalls) cash and gift cards are routine: every cash or gift-card-paid sale is debited to Square Clearing, so the bookkeeper finds a clearing balance that never clears and has to reverse it by hand each month; the page gives no per-tender split to do so.
evidence.domain: Compared with standard merchant-processor bookkeeping (gross sales less contra discounts, sales tax and tips as current liabilities, processor fees as expense, a clearing/undeposited account relieved by deposits, gift cards as deferred revenue relieved on redemption). Matches on the first four. Departs: (1) tender is not split: cash belongs in cash on hand/undeposited funds, gift-card redemptions debit Gift Cards Outstanding, other tenders to their own clearing; (2) refunds of tax are not taken out of Sales Tax Payable, overstating the liability on the return; (3) a full refund row reduces Sales directly while a partial refund goes to the Refunds account, so the two are reported inconsistently.

defects.what: Tender columns (Cash, Square Gift Card, Other Tender) are ignored: cash sales and gift-card redemptions are debited to Square Clearing, so clearing never clears against bank deposits and the gift card liability is never relieved (scenario 2: clearing 63.67 vs deposit 31.27).
Partial refunds are booked wholly to Square Refunds; the tax portion is not taken out of Sales Tax Payable, overstating the liability (54 refund with 4 tax leaves payable at 8.00, not 4.00).
An export with Net Total but no Fees column passes the column check, then books no fee (Clearing 43.30 vs Net Total 41.84) and raises an error on every row.

When Collected+Fees != Net Total, the journal uses Collected+Fees (fee can be credited as income) while the month check and deposit table use Net Total; the error text says 'The journal uses the Net Total'.
FAQ says a gift card redemption is a remainder sent to the uncategorised account, and the model says clearing returns to zero once deposits are matched; neither holds (scenario 2).

Date-order, refund-status acceptance, multi-month expected-total and positive-printed discount paths are untested (4 of 7 seeded mutants survive); tests build their CSV with the author's own buildReport.
A month that nets to zero emits a journal with one 0.00 Square Clearing line (IIF TRNS with no SPL), which importers may reject.
Copied-engine residue: Etsy comments, unused parseStatementDate/MONTHS, payout naming for months, dead '(it.gift ? 0 : 0)'.

verdict: On a card-only month the journal is right to the cent: sales, contra discounts, tax and tips as liabilities, gift card sales as a liability, refunds and fees as debits, balanced to a clearing figure that equals the summed Net Total and the Deposit ID totals, with useful row checks and honest 'from memory' limits. It misses the bar on correctness and claims: the tool ignores Square's tender columns, so every cash sale and gift-card redemption is debited to Square Clearing (which then never clears, contrary to the page) and the FAQ's gift-card-redemption claim is false; refunded sales tax stays in Sales Tax Payable; an export without a Fees column silently drops fees; and a row that fails the net check is journalled on a different figure from the one the message names. Tests pass 30/30 but caught only 3 of 7 seeded mutants.
